title: AR69003: Planning Workshop
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Skill formation Community Planning exercises. Orientation workshop through
reference studies and introductory graphic course. Identification of needs of a
community through socio-economic and physical survey- including updating a
given base map. Site planning, Housing cluster and residential sector studies layout, density, utility network and community facilities locations cost
benefit thereof. Introduction to special area problems (slum/new towns/rural
area) and preparation of their plan program. Land use interaction studies of a
small urban area and its environment. 

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion: It is a good course
